camel_example: aliyun linkwan ListNodeGroupTransferPackets --region cn-hangzhou --EndMillis 1514736000000 --Category UPLINK_PACKET --PageSize 2 --PageNumber 1 --NodeGroupId 123 --BeginMillis 1514736000000 --version 2019-03-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Invokes ListNodeGroupTransferPackets to obtain the statistics information of upstream and downstream data packets for a node group
description_zh: 调用ListNodeGroupTransferPackets获取节点分组上下行数据包的统计信息
name: ListNodeGroupTransferPackets

parameters.help_en:
The data packet category. Valid values:

DOWNLINK_PACKET: downlink packet
UPLINK_PACKET: uplink packet
parameters.help_zh:
数据包分类。取值：

DOWNLINK_PACKET：下行包
UPLINK_PACKET：上行包
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Valid value: LOG_MILLIS, which indicates that data packets are sorted by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，取值：LOG_MILLIS，表示按照时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to sort the results in ascending order. This parameter is used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order, and a value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

Base64EncodedMacPayload.description_en: The Base64-encoded MAC payload of the packet
Base64EncodedMacPayload.description_zh: Base64 编码后的 MACPayload 报文

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN class mode used when the data packet is sent or received
ClassMode.description_zh: 收发此数据包时的 LoRaWAN Class 模式

Datr.description_en: The data rate at which the data packet is sent or received
Datr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的数据速率

DevAddr.description_en: The network address of the node that sends or receives the data packet
DevAddr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的网络地址

DevEui.description_en: The DevEUI of the node that sends or receives the data packet
DevEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的 DevEUI

FPort.description_en: The FPort used to send or receive the data packet
FPort.description_zh: 收发此数据包时所使用的 FPort

Freq.description_en: The frequency at which the data packet is sent or received

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The ID of the frequency band used by the gateway that the data packet passes through
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 数据包所经过的网关所采用的频段的频段 Id

GwEui.description_en: The GwEUI of the gateway that the data packet passes through when it is sent or received
GwEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包所经过的网关的 GwEUI

GwOwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user to which the gateway that the data packet passes through belongs
GwOwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 数据包所经过网关所属用户的阿里云账号 Id

HasData.description_en: Indicates whether the data packet contains service data
HasData.description_zh: 此数据包中是否包含业务数据

HasMacCommand.description_en: Indicates whether the data packet contains a MAC command
HasMacCommand.description_zh: 此数据包中是否包含 MAC 指令

LogMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the data packet is transmitted. The value is in milliseconds
LogMillis.description_zh: 数据包传输的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

Lsnr.description_en: The signal-to-noise ratio when the data packet is sent or received
Lsnr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的信噪比

MacPayloadSize.description_en: The length of the MAC payload in the data packet
MacPayloadSize.description_zh: 此数据包的 MACPayload 报文长度

MessageType.description_en: The message type. Valid values are described in the following table

ProcessEvent.description_en: The processing result of the packet. For more information about valid values, see ProcessEvent
ProcessEvent.description_zh: 该报文的处理结果，取值内容参考 ProcessEvent 取值

Rssi.description_en: The received signal strength indicator (RSSI) when the data packet is sent or received

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data packets that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的数据包总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
